title: Market Pulse
shortDescription: Live stock, index, FX, commodity and crypto prices on your Dock. Pick single markets, whole groups or a rotating ticker. No API key needed.
description:
Market Pulse puts live market prices on the Command Palette Dock.

• Stocks, ETFs, indices, FX pairs and futures from Yahoo Finance, refreshed every 5 to 60 seconds.
• Crypto streamed live from Binance, updating about once a second. Use any coin or pair, such as BTC, ETH, SOL or ETH/BTC.
• Choose what to show: a single market, a whole group (Indices, Tech, Crypto, FX, Commodities or your own), every market in one strip, or a rotating ticker that cycles through them in one button.
• Search markets from Command Palette and add them to any group in one keystroke, or edit your watchlists as plain text in settings.
• Two-line, one-line or price-only layouts, with optional 📈/📉 trend icons.
• Click a price to open its chart; right-click to copy it.

Feeds only run for bands you can see, so unpinned markets cost nothing. No account or API key required.

Prices come from public third-party endpoints and may be delayed for some exchanges. Not investment advice.
